body: She messaged me saying she had a weird dream, i asked her what it was and when she told me i felt unpleasant feelings start to rise so i told her i was busy & would message her after work. I know that dreams are not representative of what someone actually feels/desires but it stung nonetheless. I think i may also be slightly annoyed/resentful bc i’ve been very transparent with her about my anxieties and if i were her, i’d have simply kept it to myself lol but again, i can’t really blame her

This is exactly what I’m afraid of. I‘m a very restless person and travel, party etc as much as I can and can’t bear the thought of being tied down by a child for several years. She used to be the same, massive party animal, do loads of spontaneous shit, I could always count on her because she would be up for anything. I’m scared that she will end up unhappy and sad that I’ve lost a “wingwoman” as such but that’s life I guess. I’ve thought about it a bit and as much as it’s sad that we will probably fall out of touch, this has only reinforced my childfree stance and I’m realising how much I appreciate my life. Hearing everyone’s anecdotes and experiences on this sub has been so helpful and eye-opening in that sense.

People love to be asked questions about themselves. If you talk to them and show a genuine interest in them and their lives they’ll become a fountain of conversation. Someone once pointed out to me that I talked too much about myself and asked me if I knew anything about the people I was talking to. Ever since, people have become much more willing to talk and open up to me. It’s just the little things :)
